faq_heading: Price Reduced Homes for Sale in South Surrey/White Rock: your questions answered

faq.q: How much below asking are homes selling for in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: SnapStats puts October 2026 at 95% of list price for South Surrey and White Rock detached homes (5% below) and 97% for condos and townhomes (3% below).

faq.q: Is South Surrey and White Rock a buyer's market or a seller's market?
faq.a: By the SnapStats reading, October 2026 was a buyer's market for detached homes (9% sales ratio) and a balanced market for condos and townhomes (14%). {pick('scale', c)}

faq.q: How long do South Surrey and White Rock homes take to sell?
faq.a: The typical South Surrey and White Rock detached home took 32 days to sell in October 2026, and a condo or townhome 19 days.

faq.q: Which price range has the most unsold detached homes in South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: $1,250,001 to $1,500,000, with 98 detached homes for sale and 12 sold in October 2026.

blocks.text: This search lists South Surrey and White Rock homes where the asking price has dropped by at least 1%, pulled live from the MLS®. Land and income properties are left out; houses, townhomes and condos are all included. A cut is easiest to judge against the market around it. In October 2026 a typical South Surrey and White Rock detached home sold for $1,552,500, took 32 days and closed at 95% of its list price, with 570 detached homes for sale and 54 sold in the month.
What a price drop means in South Surrey and White Rock right now

Detached homes in South Surrey and White Rock have been selling about 5% under list price, and condos and townhomes about 3% under. On the detached side the sales ratio was 9%, which SnapStats reads as a buyer's market. For condos and townhomes it was 14%, which is a balanced market. A seller who has already cut the price is usually responding to that gap, so a drop of a few percent mostly puts the home where recent buyers have been paying; a larger one is worth asking about.

Supply is the other half. At October's pace the 570 detached listings would take 10.6 months to sell, and the 561 condo and townhome listings 6.9 months. Against October 2025, detached listings are 5% fewer and detached sales 7% fewer, which is the backdrop for how many price changes you will see.
South Surrey and White Rock detached homes by area: where buyers have room

The areas where unsold detached homes are building up are the places price cuts show up first. In October that was Morgan Creek (45 listings, 2% sales ratio), Grandview (67 listings, 3% sales ratio), King George Corridor (84 listings, 4% sales ratio). The fastest-moving area was Sunnyside Park, at a 25% ratio on 11 sales, so cuts there tend to be small or short-lived.

blocks.text: Price ranges with the most unsold South Surrey and White Rock detached homes

The busiest price range for listings was $1,250,001 to $1,500,000, with 98 homes for sale and 12 sold. The slowest of the well-stocked ranges were $2,500,001 to $2,750,000 (31 for sale, 1 sold); $3,500,001 to $4,000,000 (23 for sale, 1 sold); $2,250,001 to $2,500,000 (45 for sale, 2 sold). Those are the ranges where a negotiated price below the list price is least surprising.

blocks.text: Condos and townhomes in South Surrey and White Rock

Condos and townhomes sold at a median $700,000 in South Surrey and White Rock, after 19 days. The most crowded price range was $800,001 to $900,000, with 93 for sale and 12 sold. By area, White Rock had the most listings (189, 22 sold), then Grandview (143, 23 sold).
